baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence "do not enter" / "houses other than yours" / "until tasta'nisu" / "greet their people."
baseline_models.mechanism: A dwelling is an opaque inside belonging to an affiliated human group. Sensory recognition and a peaceful greeting must convert approach to an acknowledged encounter before the entrant crosses from outside to inside.

activation_trace.role: Literal passage into an inside supplies the threshold crossing that is delayed.
Shelter and dwelling supplies the protected spatial interior beyond the threshold.
Perceiving by sight, hearing, or felt awareness makes human presence ascertainable before crossing.
Peace-making against hostility makes the greeting a non-threatening mode of approach.
The affiliated inhabitants, not the structure alone, are the relational endpoint of recognition and greeting.

changed_reading.before: The ayah requires a preliminary courtesy before entering another person's house.
changed_reading.after: The ayah requires a transition from opaque shelter to mutually recognized human encounter: ascertain presence, announce peace, and only then cross the threshold.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of entry with another household's houses and people.
baseline_models.mechanism: Entering is also access to an inward, potentially secret domain; "other" marks the entrant's lack of prior belonging, while recognition and safety protect the household interior from surprise exposure and protect both sides from harm.

activation_trace.role: The inward and secret side of entry supplies the privacy-bearing interior that crossing can expose.
House as household and dependents shifts protection from walls to the people whose interior life is enclosed.
Otherness and difference marks the entrant as outside the household's preexisting sphere.
Prior seeing, hearing, or sensing prevents an uninformed collision with the concealed interior.
Freedom from injury makes the greeting procedure serve mutual safety rather than etiquette alone.

changed_reading.before: The protected object is another person's real property.
changed_reading.after: The protected object is the household's inward life: the rule blocks surprise access to people, secrets, and vulnerable domestic states, not merely trespass against walls.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ordered verbs tasta'nisu and tusallimu before entry, followed by "better for you" and remembrance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The entrant first removes estrangement and then symbolically hands the interaction over to the household. Repetition turns this yielding of initiative into a remembered choice rather than an assertion of unilateral access.

activation_trace.role: Familiarity that removes estrangement supplies the social softening before any claim to enter.
A greeting that finds spacious welcome among one's people supplies the hospitable relation sought, without presuming it.
Handing over and relinquishing supplies an exploratory image of yielding control of the next move to the inhabitants.
Choosing what is better frames restraint at the threshold as an active preference, not passive delay.
Recollection after forgetfulness makes the repeated threshold act a discipline against habitual presumption.

changed_reading.before: The visitor performs two courtesies and then may proceed.
changed_reading.after: The visitor yields initiative to the household and waits for relationship to be offered; the remembered virtue is relinquishing unilateral control at another's threshold.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding accusation sequence shows falsehood arriving, being taken onto tongues, becoming circulating speech, and spreading publicly. An announced, acknowledged entrance creates a socially legible encounter before access to an intimate interior, reducing the ambiguous hidden contact from which harmful stories can be manufactured.

activation_trace.role: Access to an inward or secret domain supplies the kind of encounter whose opacity can become socially dangerous.
Audible or visible recognition supplies a checkable sign of the encounter before entry.
Falsehood diverted from truth supplies the reputational harm against which legible access can be prophylactic.
Receiving and passing speech supplies the hand-to-hand transmission mechanism for an ambiguous report.
Speech becoming widespread among people supplies the escalation from private ambiguity to public claim.
Diffusion and public spread supplies the final social amplification that threshold legibility can interrupt.

structural_cues: 24:11-19 moves from fabricated report through tongue-to-mouth circulation to public diffusion immediately before the household-access command.
The focus ayah itself makes entry audible and relational through recognition and greeting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opaque interior access plus a staged anatomy of rumor; I infer that announced entry blocks one source of ambiguous hidden encounters. A live alternative is that the command protects privacy without any intended evidentiary function.

changed_reading.before: Permission protects only the household from intrusion.
changed_reading.after: Recognition and greeting also protect both visitor and household by making intimate access publicly intelligible before rumor can supply its own account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel converts preliminary recognition into a response-governed process: entry remains barred until authorization, and a negative response obliges actual retreat. The household therefore controls whether recognition culminates in access.

activation_trace.role: Perceiving or hearing presence supplies the initial contact but no longer suffices by itself.
Relinquishing control supplies the focus-side posture that explicit authorization and refusal make concrete.
Express permission and license supplies the decisive condition for crossing.
Returning to the prior position supplies the required bodily consequence of refusal.
Purity and soundness evaluates accepting refusal as self-cleansing rather than social defeat.

structural_cues: 24:28 repeats the entry prohibition, places permission after the until-clause, and repeats the command to return.
The evaluative phrase shifts from "better" in 24:27 to "purer" in 24:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit permission, refusal, and return in the immediate sequel; I infer that tasta'nisu opens a request whose outcome belongs to the household. A live alternative is that tasta'nisu denotes announcement while permission remains a distinct second requirement.

changed_reading.before: Once the visitor has announced presence and greeted, entry is presumptively available.
changed_reading.after: Announcement initiates consent rather than completing it: the inhabitants may authorize, remain unavailable, or refuse, and the visitor's duty includes leaving without contest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next exception permits access to non-inhabited houses containing useful goods. That exception shifts the protected interest from non-ownership as such to inhabited and concealed domestic life, while legitimate utility can justify entry where that interest is absent.

activation_trace.role: Dwelling and shelter supplies the category that the sequel subdivides by habitation.
Otherness initially appears to make every non-self house equally restricted.
Settled habitation supplies the missing property that distinguishes a private dwelling from the allowed exception.
A useful thing serving practical needs supplies the legitimate purpose for entering the uninhabited structure.
What is made outwardly apparent supplies one side of the accountability attached to access.
What is hidden and covered supplies the concealed side that remains morally visible even under the exception.

structural_cues: 24:29 repeats entering, houses, and otherness but inserts "not inhabited" and "useful goods for you."
The closing contrast between what is disclosed and concealed preserves accountability after granting the exception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a same-vocabulary exception keyed to non-habitation and utility; I infer that privacy-bearing occupancy, not masonry or foreign ownership alone, drives the rule. A live alternative is that the exception names a narrow public-commercial license without stating the rule's general rationale.

changed_reading.before: Every house not owned by the entrant lies under one undifferentiated entry ban.
changed_reading.after: The boundary is calibrated to inhabited privacy: a non-owned utility structure can be entered when no household interior is at stake, though hidden motives remain accountable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following gaze and concealment commands extend the threshold from bodily location to information flow. Tasta'nisu may use sight or hearing to verify presence, but authorization to enter does not authorize unrestricted looking; perception must be reduced and vulnerable disclosure guarded.

activation_trace.role: Seeing, hearing, and sensing supplies the perceptual channel used to establish presence before entry.
The inward and secret domain supplies the information-rich space whose visibility remains bounded after entry.
Withholding and lowering by reduction supplies the entrant's restraint over visual uptake.
Literal eyesight identifies the information channel that must remain governed.
Guarding inviolability and chastity supplies the protected vulnerability beyond the doorway.
Appearance and outward display supplies what can become visible in the domestic encounter.
Concealment supplies what the observer must not attempt to extract merely because entry occurred.

structural_cues: 24:30-31 immediately follows the entry rules with parallel commands governing male and female sight, guarding, display, and concealment.
The focus verb's sensory branch and the sequel's gaze restrictions create a deliberate tension between enough perception to recognize and excess perception that appropriates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sensory recognition followed by explicit reduction of sight and protection of concealed exposure; I infer a threshold for information as well as bodies. A live alternative is that gaze discipline is adjacent moral instruction rather than an extension of entry protocol.

changed_reading.before: Obtaining permission resolves the privacy problem and grants ordinary visual access inside.
changed_reading.after: Permission governs bodily crossing but not visual possession: one may verify enough to coordinate entry while remaining obligated not to harvest the household's concealed life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later promise replaces fear with security using the same root that names the focus addressees. Joined to the greeting's safety branch, belief becomes a practical obligation to reproduce aman at the smallest social boundary: another household should not experience the believer's arrival as threat.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settled security and trust turns the address "those who believe" into a functional security-bearing identity.
Freedom from harm makes greeting the local enactment of the security named by belief.
One condition taking the place of another supplies the explicit reversal from fear to security.
Anticipatory fear supplies the condition that intrusive arrival can reproduce at household scale.
Security after fear supplies the surah-level outcome that recognition and greeting enact locally.

structural_cues: 24:27 addresses believers and requires a safety-bearing greeting; 24:55 places belief and security within a fear-to-security reversal.
The same root joins identity, trust, and the promised social condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared root and a fear-to-security reversal; I infer a micro-to-macro arrow in which threshold conduct produces the social quality promised later. A live alternative is that 24:55 concerns collective security without feeding back into household etiquette.

changed_reading.before: "Those who believe" merely identifies who must obey the entry rule.
changed_reading.after: The address assigns a role: believers must make their approach trustworthy, actively converting the household's possible fear into safety before seeking access.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later household rules require routine circulators to seek permission at three vulnerable times and require maturing children to begin seeking it generally. Privacy therefore follows temporal exposure and developmental relation inside one's own home, not only the street-facing boundary between owner and stranger.

activation_trace.role: Household and dependents supplies the social interior within which new thresholds can arise.
Explicit permission supplies an internal access requirement even for people already circulating through the household.
The appointed time of a state supplies a temporal rather than architectural boundary.
What must remain covered supplies the vulnerability that makes certain times privacy-bearing.
Routine circulation around others supplies the ordinary access that is suspended at vulnerable times.
Reaching maturity supplies a developmental change in who must recognize the boundary.
Repeated permission after maturity generalizes the internal threshold beyond the three stated times.

structural_cues: 24:58 names three privacy times despite ordinary mutual circulation; 24:59 changes the rule when children reach maturity.
These later ayat reuse the same permission procedure within "your" household, reversing the focus contrast with "other than your houses."
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies permission tied to vulnerable times, circulation, and maturity; I infer that protected privacy is a moving state inside social space. A live alternative is to treat these as separate household regulations rather than a revision of the focus boundary model.

changed_reading.before: Privacy begins at the outer door and primarily separates strangers from the household.
changed_reading.after: Privacy boundaries arise wherever exposure changes, including inside one's own house; time, vulnerability, and maturity can temporarily turn familiar space into space requiring renewed permission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The long list of kin, entrusted access, and friendship makes household access a graded relational network rather than a binary of mine and alien. When entry is followed by greeting "yourselves," reciprocal peace can fold distinct households into a social self without erasing their separate control.

activation_trace.role: Difference and otherness supplies the initial sharp division between your houses and houses not yours.
Possession and authorized control supplies one basis for standing access within the listed network.
A means of reaching what is closed supplies entrusted access through held keys.
Sincere companionship supplies friendship as a relation capable of bearing limited household access.
Literal entry repeats the focus crossing after the kinship and access list.
Safety and freedom from harm makes greeting the condition that preserves trust within broad access.
The self or very identity supplies the surprising recoding of greeting other household members as greeting yourselves.
A greeting that invokes life and peace supplies the reciprocal bond through which separate people act as one social self.

structural_cues: 24:61 enumerates one's own house, close kin, controlled keys, and a friend before repeating entry and greeting.
The object of greeting changes from "its people" in 24:27 to "yourselves" in 24:61.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies graded relationships, entrusted keys, friendship, and self-directed greeting; I infer a relational topology in which legitimate access can reduce alterity. A live alternative is that the list regulates eating privileges only and leaves the earlier permission rule wholly untouched.

changed_reading.before: Household space divides cleanly into one's own domain and an undifferentiated domain of others.
changed_reading.after: Domestic access is relationally graded: kinship, entrusted control, and friendship can create standing forms of access, while greeting preserves reciprocal personhood rather than converting access into ownership.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the surah's end, permission governs leaving a shared affair, while slipping away under another's cover is exposed as the corrupt alternative. This reverses the focus direction but preserves its mechanism: changes in relational presence should be announced, recognized, and consented to rather than accomplished invisibly.

activation_trace.role: Movement into an inside supplies the original direction of the socially governed transition.
Perceptible recognition supplies the anti-stealth quality of legitimate crossing.
Gathering dispersed persons into one whole supplies the shared relational space from which departure matters.
Going away supplies the reverse-direction crossing that also requires permission.
Repeated authorization supplies consent for leaving the common affair just as it supplied consent for entering privacy.
Secret extraction supplies the illegible departure opposed to announced transition.
Hiding behind another supplies the social cover by which recognition and accountability are evaded.

structural_cues: 24:62 repeatedly requires permission before leaving a collective matter; 24:63 immediately depicts covert withdrawal behind others.
The end-of-surah reversal mirrors 24:27-28: entry into another's sphere and exit from a shared sphere both alter who may rely on one's presence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies permission for departure and condemns concealed slipping away; I infer a bidirectional rule of legible relational transition. A live alternative is that leadership in a collective affair creates a special duty that should not be generalized to domestic entry.

changed_reading.before: The focus rule is a one-way domestic etiquette concerning entry from outside.
changed_reading.after: Domestic entry is one instance of a broader consent pattern: whenever presence or absence changes another's relational situation, the transition should become perceptible and answerable rather than stealthy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the mirage and layered-darkness passages concern failed perception at a cosmic scale, not doors. It remains anchored in tasta'nisu's packet branch of seeing, hearing, and sensing before entry, and the context repeatedly contrasts supposition, finding, occlusion, and sight. Downstream prose should present it as an epistemic resonance, not as a lexical equation or exclusive gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Tasta'nisu as perceptual verification before crossing an unseen threshold.

activation_trace.role: Sensing by sight, sound, or inner awareness supplies the focus requirement to verify rather than presume.
Supposition supplies the mistaken confidence by which an apparent resource is taken as real.
Actually finding or failing to find supplies the correction of appearance by encountered reality.
A covering that occludes supplies the opposite perceptual failure: reality present but unavailable to sight.
Literal seeing supplies the faculty shown to be unreliable under layered darkness.

changed_reading.before: The visitor can treat a quick sign of occupancy as straightforward knowledge that permits approach.
changed_reading.after: The pause before entry disciplines uncertain perception: do not convert appearance, silence, or assumption into a claim on another's interior; seek an answerable sign.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the light-and-houses sequence back onto a mundane access rule. It remains anchored by the repeated house, permission, and remembrance roots, with light supplying a context image for an interior made manifest without being violated. Downstream prose should mark this as architectural-theological resonance, not claim that 24:27 directly defines light or sacred houses.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins houses, a restrained crossing, greeting, benefit, and remembrance.

activation_trace.role: Dwelling as shelter supplies the domestic container that later bears the light image.
Recollection supplies the focus movement from threshold practice to remembered order.
Illumination supplies an interior manifestation that reveals without the visitor forcibly exposing it.
The repeated dwelling supplies the explicit architectural bridge back to the focus houses.
Authorization supplies the condition under which the house is elevated rather than breached.
Raising supplies the changed status of a house ordered by authorization and remembrance.
Voiced remembrance supplies an audible, licit manifestation inside the authorized house.

changed_reading.before: The entry rule merely limits access to an already private container.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, authorized and peace-bearing access helps constitute the house as a light-bearing place: its interior becomes manifest through welcomed remembrance rather than forced exposure.

strongest_changes: 24:28 turns tasta'nisu from a preliminary courtesy into a consent process whose possible outcomes include refusal and mandatory retreat.
24:29 and 24:58-61 show that the protected boundary follows habitation, vulnerable times, maturity, and relationships rather than a simple property line.
24:30-31 extends access control from bodily entry to visual information, while 24:11-19 makes legible entry protective against rumor and reputational ambiguity.
24:62-63 reverses the direction of movement and exposes a broader pattern: socially consequential transitions in presence should not be stealthy.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet transformed a door rule into a calibrated system of relational legibility. Recognition, permission, gaze restraint, temporal privacy, reciprocal greeting, and accountable departure all govern when another person's interior or reliance may be crossed.
remaining_uncertainties: Tasta'nisu can still weight sensory detection, removal of estrangement, announcement, or permission-seeking differently; the packet keeps these functions adjacent without collapsing them.
The anti-rumor function is mechanistically coherent but remains an inferred prophylaxis rather than an explicit purpose clause.
The access list in 24:61 may modify only eating privilege, so its effect on the earlier permission rule should remain qualified.
The failed-perception and light-bearing-house outliers are cross-domain resonances and should not displace the direct authorization and privacy readings.
